headline: Quarry Systems wins quality award from industry association
body: Quarry Systems received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Quarry Systems opens new production line in Austin
body: Quarry Systems commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Quarry Systems reports minor shipment delays at Austin plant
body: Quarry Systems confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Austin plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Quarry Systems appoints new regional sales director
body: Quarry Systems announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Quarry Systems publishes annual sustainability report
body: Quarry Systems released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Quarry Systems signs multi-year framework agreement
